title: Human Engineering — Usability and Human-Systems Measurement Atlas
status: editorial research catalog; not certification authority

constructs.label: Effectiveness
constructs.definition: Accuracy and completeness of goal achievement

constructs.label: Efficiency
constructs.definition: Resources expended in achieving goals, conditioned on effectiveness

constructs.label: Satisfaction
constructs.definition: Positive or negative attitudes to using the system

constructs.label: Ease of use
constructs.definition: Perceived effort and complexity of interaction

constructs.label: Learnability
constructs.definition: Acquisition and retention of task proficiency

constructs.label: Error tolerance and recoverability
constructs.definition: Prevention, detection, correction and impact of interaction errors

constructs.label: Trust and reliance
constructs.definition: Appropriate trust, compliance, reliance and calibration

constructs.label: Workload
constructs.definition: Experienced mental, physical, temporal and resource demand

constructs.label: Visual workload
constructs.definition: Allocation of visual sampling and ocular processing under task demands

constructs.label: Control and motor workload
constructs.definition: Inceptor, motor control and physical activity demands

constructs.label: Situation awareness
constructs.definition: Accurate perception, comprehension and projection of task-relevant state

constructs.label: Attention allocation
constructs.definition: Selection and distribution of perceptual/cognitive resources

constructs.label: Readability
constructs.definition: Ease of reading extended or structured textual information

constructs.label: Legibility
constructs.definition: Discriminability of characters, symbols and markings

constructs.label: Interface comprehension
constructs.definition: Accurate interpretation of symbols, quantities, states, meanings and implications

constructs.label: Findability and discoverability
constructs.definition: Ability to locate needed functions and information

constructs.label: Interface navigation
constructs.definition: Movement through menu trees, displays and operating modes

constructs.label: Alerting and annunciation
constructs.definition: Detection, classification, acknowledgment and response to indications

constructs.label: Automation and mode awareness
constructs.definition: Understanding active/armed/requested modes and authority

constructs.label: Decision quality
constructs.definition: Accuracy, timeliness and appropriateness of choices

constructs.label: Flight and handling performance
constructs.definition: Pilot–aircraft control outcomes in reference scenarios

constructs.label: Mission-task performance
constructs.definition: Achievement of operational task goals and constraints

constructs.label: Communication
constructs.definition: Clarity, economy, accuracy and timeliness of voice interactions

constructs.label: Touch, pointer and HOTAS interactions
constructs.definition: Physical control use, paths, timing and mis-selections

constructs.label: Display and HMD fidelity
constructs.definition: Registration, latency, coordinate accuracy and perceptual stability

constructs.label: Accessibility and accommodations
constructs.definition: Performance across physical/perceptual access constraints

constructs.label: Preference and tradeoffs
constructs.definition: Comparative judgments and stated selection among designs

constructs.label: Fatigue and vigilance
constructs.definition: Sustained monitoring effectiveness over time

constructs.label: Crew coordination
constructs.definition: Coordination and cross-verification of crew actions

constructs.label: Comfort and adverse effects
constructs.definition: Physical comfort, simulator sickness and discomfort

constructs.label: Risk and safety margin
constructs.definition: Exposure to operational hazards and time available to act
